chapterIdea: Bench press start and bottom positions
subject: Two matched oblique views of a faceless adult supine on a flat bench. A full Olympic barbell with large plates, collars and sleeves starts above the shoulder joints and ends touching the lower sternum, with the entire head and neck clear.
checks: Full 2.2 m Olympic bar proportion from the code guide; both approximately 45 cm plates are outside the hands, with collars and visible outer sleeves.
Grip is slightly wider than shoulder width; start arms are straight and the shaft is vertically above the shoulder joints.
End shaft touches the lower sternum; elbows open about 45–75 degrees from torso; neither plate nor shaft covers the face or neck.
Flat bench, head supported on the pad, both feet flat on the floor; consistent camera and scale across both frames.
Faceless graphite figure, light hatching, single clean arrow; no text, detached parts, extra limbs or fingers.
Final 1200x800 alpha WebP is under 120 KB; exact final pixels inspected at 420, 840 and native 2x in paper and cinema simulations, alongside three accepted images.
